Only a model swap can change behaviour. gpt-5-4-mini (r2) and qwen3-next (r3) both scored speak_and_act=0 because they speak the scripted line without calling the tool in the same response. With speak-and-act weighted x1 out of 4, that caps their quality near 0.40, below the 0.4855 floor. gpt-5-4-nano (same family) and the Llama models will probably fail the same way. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is the only unevaluated model that plausibly returns content together with tool_calls, and the probe accepted it on the serving route with temp 0.3 and max_completion_tokens. Note that mini cut premature transfers to 9, so another model family can be more careful at the transfer gate. Predicted: speak_and_act ~0.5-0.65, action_correct ~0.62-0.70, quality ~0.48-0.55, premature_transfers 6-12. Main risk is latency (unmeasured; must stay at or below ~635ms median); if it is slower, or if every row errors, revert and next round try noop or gpt-5-4-nano for latency only.
